T: Dinner at Dex's. Ask no questions.
D: Ten years on, Anakin protects Padmé while Obi-Wan uncovers a secret clone army.
P: Serve the mains when Obi-Wan walks into Dex's Diner on Coruscant.
S: Anakin floating a piece of fruit across the table to Padmé
Pear and melon cubes speared on toothpicks, drizzled with honey and lime, arranged on a long platter as if they are hovering.
Tipoca City salt and vinegar fish bites
the ocean planet of Kamino, where it never stops raining

Flathead pieces in a crisp salt and vinegar crumb, fried golden, with a sharp dill pickle and caper tartare and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into bite pieces and soak in 3 tbsp malt vinegar for 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 100g panko mixed with 1 tsp salt. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped dill pickle, capers, dill and lemon juice. Sprinkle the fish with more salt and vinegar.
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery red chilli glaze of sriracha, honey and butter.
M: Dexter Jettster's greasy diner on Coruscant
Thick beef patty melts with caramelised onions and Swiss cheese on rye, grilled in butter, with crinkle fries and a pickle.
Anakin and Padmé on the grass at the Naboo lake retreat

Lamb cutlets grilled pink with rosemary and lemon, with a warm new potato salad, green beans and a bright salsa verde to spoon over. Boil 800g new potatoes until tender and halve. Blanch 300g green beans. Blitz parsley, mint, a garlic clove, 1 tbsp capers, 2 anchovies, lemon juice and 100ml olive oil into a salsa verde. Rub 12 lamb cutlets with oil, rosemary, lemon zest and salt and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Toss the potatoes and beans with half the salsa verde and serve with the cutlets.
W: White chocolate mousse set in glasses, topped with whipped cream and a thin square of dark chocolate.
K: Strong drip coffee in thick mugs with hot milk and sugar on the side.

s.note: Anakin floating a piece of fruit across the table to Padmé
s.how: Cut 2 pears, a quarter rockmelon and a quarter honeydew into cubes and spear on toothpicks. Drizzle with honey and lime. Arrange on a long platter so they look like they're hovering.
Bake 1kg chicken wings at 220C for 45 minutes. Melt 3 tbsp chilli sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 40g butter and toss through. Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

m.note: Dexter Jettster's greasy diner on Coruscant
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly until golden. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin patties and sear. Layer on 8 slices rye with the onions and 4 slices Swiss, butter the outside and grill until melted. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.how: Melt 150g white chocolate into 100ml warm cream and cool. Fold through 200ml whipped cream and a whisked egg white. Set in 4 glasses for 4 hours. Top with whipped cream and a thin square of dark chocolate.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine so it comes out strong. Pour into thick diner mugs and serve with hot milk and raw sugar on the side, the way Dex runs his counter.
